The present complaint is being filed by Mr. Digwanta Chakraborty, the authorized representative of Outscalepartners India Private Limited (Formerly known as AMH Services Private Limited), a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, having CIN U74999HR2022FTC100335 and having its registered office at Vatika Business Park, 5th Floor, Block A, Sohna Road, Sector 49, Gurgaon, Haryana – 122018, India (“Complainant”).

The Accused Person i.e., Mr. Vipin Ujjainwal is one of the employees of the Complainant Company. The details of Mr. Vipin Ujjainwal are as follows 
(a)	Employee ID 50839
(b)	Residential Address R-3/113 Nawada Housing Complex, Dwarka Mod, New Delhi-110059
(c)	Mobile Number 8076269426
(d)	Email ID  dd0286111gmail.com

Mr. Ujjainwal commenced his employment with the Complainant on February 23, 2026 in the position of Senior Associate- Command Centre. Thereafter, while Mr. Ujjainwal was still within his probation period, serious allegations were raised against him regarding the unauthorized removal and suspected theft of three company-issued laptops, which were last recorded to be in his possession. 

Accordingly, the Complainant issued a show cause notice to Mr. Ujjainwal on March 31, 2026 inter alia seeking Mr. Ujjainwals response to the allegations by April 06, 2026.

The details of the company assets, including the company-issued laptops which are in his wrongful possession are as follows 

(a)	Laptop No. 1 – 
Make Lenovo 
Model Number E14-ADP 
Serial Number/ Product ID PF622CGJ / GGN-LP-PF622CGJ-584 
Colour Black

Serial Number/ Product ID PF622CH1 / GGN-LP-PF622CH1-566 
Colour Black

(d)	Jabra EV20 headphones
(e)	Dell USB Mouse
(f)	Access  ID card

Till date, the Complainant has not received any response from Mr. Ujjainwal. However, upon review of the CCTV footage, it was observed that Mr. Ujjainwal has wrongfully obtained possession of three company-issued laptops, and thereafter, he failed to resume work and/or return the said assets to the Complainant. If required, the Complainant can submit the relevant CCTV footage for the necessary action.

It is pertinent to mention that the said laptops contain confidential information, trade secrets, and intellectual property belonging to the Complainant as well as third parties. Therefore, it is critical that the laptops are returned at the earliest, to prevent any further risk of unauthorized access or misuse. 
In view of the above, the willful action on the part of Mr. Ujjainwal in not returning the laptop and company assets by dishonestly taking it out of the possession of the Complainant without its consent warrants action under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and such other provisions as may be applicable under the law. 

Further, Mr. Ujjainwal is also liable for payment of fine and punishment under Section 452 of the Companies Act, 2013 for wrongful withholding of property of the company.

The Complainant hereby requests that cognizance of this complaint is taken, and a FIR is registered against the Accused Person i.e., Mr. Vipin Ujjainwal.
